defects.canonical: The docstring promises bankers rounding (round half to even), but the implementation rounds the tax with ROUND_HALF_UP, so every total whose fractional cent lands on a .5 boundary rounds up instead of to the nearest even cent. Over many lines this is a small systematic upward bias that violates the stated half-to-even contract.
defects.why_subtle: It is a single rounding-mode argument that looks deliberate and correct in isolation; only reading the promised half-to-even against the half-up actually used reveals the mismatch.
